+"""Directed residual tangent transport auxiliary objective."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Transport codebook offsets along source->target residual directions.
+
+    Gradients flow through both endpoints and the codebook. Nearest-code indices
+    are intentionally discrete; the soft source-conditioned transport and
+    distance hinge provide the differentiable paths.
+    """
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    margin = parameters.get("minimum_pair_code_distance", 0.1)
+    kappa = parameters.get("separation_weight", 0.1)
+    temperature = parameters.get("temperature", 4.0)
+    weight = parameters.get("weight", 0.01)
+
+    residual = target - source
+    direction = residual / (residual.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    offsets = codebook.unsqueeze(0) - source.unsqueeze(1)
+    tangent = offsets - (offsets * direction.unsqueeze(1)).sum(-1, keepdim=True) * direction.unsqueeze(1)
+    similarity = source @ codebook.transpose(0, 1)
+    probabilities = F.softmax(temperature * similarity, dim=-1)
+    transport = (probabilities * (tangent - residual.unsqueeze(1)).pow(2).sum(-1)).sum(-1)
+
+    # Explicitly directed endpoint assignments: source selects a_i, target selects b_i.
+    a = similarity.argmax(dim=-1)
+    b = (target @ codebook.transpose(0, 1)).argmax(dim=-1)
+    pair_distance = (codebook[a] - codebook[b]).norm(dim=-1)
+    separation = (margin - pair_distance).clamp_min(0).pow(2)
+
+    per_pair = transport - kappa * separation
+    return weight * (per_pair * mask.to(per_pair.dtype)).mean()
